hook: Set up in 1930, the Bank for International Settlements serves as a bank for central banks.

sections.voiceover: Set up in 1930, the Bank for International Settlements serves as a bank for central banks.

text_overlay.text: The Central Bank of Central Banks

sections.voiceover: Founded in 1930, the Bank for International Settlements operates quietly in Basel. Reuters calls it one of the world's most opaque institutions, but what really happens there?
However, historian Adam LeBor investigated the institution's hidden history in Tower of Basel.
b_roll: Cover of Tower of Basel book

sections.voiceover: Reuters documented the profound global influence of the Bank for International Settlements.
Tower of Basel reveals the institution created in 1930.
